steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Series circuit: A circuit where components are connected one after the other in a single loop. There is only one path for the current to flow. | Parallel circuit: A circuit where components are connected in separate branches. Each branch provides a different path for the current. | Adding resistors in parallel: When you add a resistor in parallel, you provide an extra path for current. This means the total resistance decreases because more current can flow overall. | Adding resistors in series: When you add a resistor in series, you make it harder for current to flow through the single loop. The total resistance increases .
